setup: [a match from a dating app, or a wrong-number hello, moves to [chat app name] and turns affectionate within days] [the person will not meet or video call and says their camera is broken]
ask: [after weeks of affection, the person who still will not meet or show their face says a crisis has come up, a ticket, a hospital bill, or a shared investment, and asks the player to send money, a little more than last time]
usualEnding: The transfers repeat, each with a new reason, and many of these chats turn into the investment pattern. The person in the photos never existed.
